newsitem.title: UK: Melrose close to Russian oil and gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Melrose close to Russian oil and gas deal.

text.p: Melrose Energy Plc said it was close to making a significant investment in a Russian gas and oil venture, and it expects to be able to give more information in the next 10 days.
The company was reacting to a report in the Mail on Sunday newspaper, which said that Melrose was about to take a stake of up to 20 percent in Russian company Evikhon.
Evikhon is developing three oil fields in Western Siberia through a joint venture, called Salym Petroleum Development, with Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
Melrose shares rose six pence to 50-1/2 pence on the report.

The oil production and exploration company said the planned Russian investments would, if agreement is reached, be made through a new subsidiary, set up especially for the purpose. Melrose would be the majority shareholder.
Melrose would also place new shares to fund the investment.
